bug_description: torch.mul does not support multiplication involving CUDA bool tensors although the operation works correctly on CPU and worked in previous PyTorch versions.

trigger_conditions.operation_context: Performing multiplication between boolean values and CUDA boolean tensors.

failure_behavior.description: The operation raises RuntimeError because CUDA multiplication kernel for Bool dtype is not implemented.

root_cause_information.description: The bug is related to unsupported dtype and backend combinations during operator execution.
